play.title: Write a story, play it at once
play.lead: Edit the JSON on the Edit tab. After every change the real engine checks your story and, if nothing is broken, starts a new game on the Play tab.
play.step1: Open Edit JSON and change a text, an item or a number.
play.step2: Read the checker: errors say where the problem is, like nodes.door.choices[0].
play.step3: Switch to Play to try it. Download keeps your work; Open file loads a story from your computer.
player.cannotPlay: Fix the errors on the Edit tab to play again.
